# ETH: physical ionization energy [eV], NIST ASD snapshot 2022-11-15

# PHOTO: E_th[eV] E0 sigma0[Mb] ya P yw y0 y1 (VFKY96 outer shell, phfit2.f PH2; valid below E_inn)
# PHINNER: E_inn[eV] (phfit2 einn; at E >= E_inn, or always when E_inn = 0, sigma = sum of the PHSHELL fits)
# PHSHELL: l E_th[eV] E0 sigma0[Mb] ya P yw (Verner & Yakovlev 1995 subshell fit, phfit2.f PH1)
# PHTABLE: n, then n rows eps[eV] sigma[Mb] (R-matrix ground-term cross section against the photoelectron energy eps = E - ETH, linear in eps; replaces PHOTO below E_join = ETH + eps_n, where it equals PHOTO; tools/fitting/ground_term_photoionization_table.py)
# CI: dE[eV] P A X K (Voronov 1997, cfit.f)
# RR: A B T0 T1 C T2 (Badnell/Strathclyde TAMOC, data/atomic/badnell_rr.dat M=1; else CHIANTI v11.0.2 .rrparams)
# DR: n, c_i [cm^3 s^-1 K^1.5], E_i [K] (Badnell/Strathclyde TAMOC, data/atomic/badnell_dr.dat M=1; else CHIANTI .drparams; n=0 if absent)
# DR2: A B T0 T1 (Shull & Van Steenberg 1982 form, alpha = A T^-3/2 e^-T0/T (1 + B e^-T1/T))
# RR2: A eta (power law alpha = A (T/1e4)^-eta; CHIANTI rrparams type 3)
# CXI/CXR: form, 6 coefficients (charge exchange with H+ / H0; transition 1 from Huang et al. 2023 Table 4, nitrogen from Kingdon & Ferland 1996;
#   forms: 0 none; 1 a(T/300)^b exp(-c/T4); 2 aT4^b + cT4^d; 3 (aT4^b + cT4^d)exp(-e/T);
#   4 exp(sum c_k lnT^k); 5 form4*exp(-c6/T4);
#   6 a t4^b (1 + c exp(d t4)) (Kingdon & Ferland 1996; first-transition t4 clamped to 0.5-5, except N: 0.01-5);
#   7 form6*exp(-e/t4) (KF96 with an activation barrier; only the form-6 part is clamped, exp(-e/t4) takes the actual T);
#   8 tabulated: CXRTAB n T_1..T_n [K] k_1..k_n [cm^3 s^-1], log-log in T, T clamped to the table (Barragan et al. 2006 for N2+ and O2+; KF96 Table 1 for other higher rates);
#   9 resolved by product term (sulfur, Zhao et al. 2005 Table III): CXSTATE nterm nT g_react dIP[eV]; CXSTATET T_1..T_n; CXSTATEK label lev_lo lev_hi g E[eV] k_1..k_n (forward rate into that term).  Forward = sum over terms; reverse = sum over terms of pop_j(T, n_e) k_j g_react/(2 g_j) exp(-(dIP - E_j)/kT), pop_j from the n-level atom of the product ion)
# CXHEAT: dE_ion dE_rec g_split -- kinetic energy [eV] given to the gas by one X^it + H+ -> X^(it+1) + H event (dE_ion) and one X^(it+1) + H -> X^it + H+ event (dE_rec),
#   dE = dIP - E_rad (E_rad: product excitation that radiates, or the photon of radiative charge transfer; < 0 endothermic); 0 where no rate is carried;
#   g_split > 0: the ionization rate includes radiative charge transfer and only its non-radiative part, the detailed-balance reverse of the recombination rate with this statistical-weight ratio, heats
